prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity landscape raster concept for the existing Legend of the Five Rings Emperor Edition desktop card game, approximately 1920x1080. This is a proposed interface.
Image 1 is actual game layout reference, image 2 the approved lacquer/typography reference. Preserve warm wooden fortress room, navy patterned mat, physical full uncropped cards, stacked attachments, thin weathered brass edges, black lacquer, readable ivory Caudex-like serif and restrained brush headings. Keep player placards, top six-phase rail and bottom hand recognizable. Enough table context but new UI large and readable. No website/dashboard restyling, modern rounded cards, neon, translucent ghost cards, decorative statistics, invented gameplay rules, API names, issue numbers or A/B/C annotations inside the game. Do not invent readable card rules text.
Show one coherent state with generous breathing room, minimal ornament, selected outline/check and text not relying on color. Design for keyboard and reduced motion. No external plaque below the battle court. Never cover right-side spear/Force ribbons with badges.

Feature:
Input3 is court composition only, NOT its old four-phase HUD. Keep input1 SIX phases STRAIGHTEN, EVENTS, ACTION, ATTACK, DYNASTY, END, highlight ATTACK. Current example: local Crane defender took first action by default; Lion has now passed, Crane acts. Exact "BATTLE ACTIONS", "Province 1", "Your action · Crane", "Defender took the first action", "1 consecutive pass", "Passing now proceeds to resolution.", "Pass battle action".
Formal sequence Declaration, Infantry Maneuvers, Cavalry Maneuvers, Fight Battles, Resolution. Fight Battles contains battlefield choice, Engage, alternating Battle actions. Resolution contains before-resolution effects then outcome. Prior steps quiet/current clear. Battle cycle repeats for other battlefields. No match-ended message, skip-all, autoplay or invented automatic passing; no persistent Force totals. Leave inspector room for actual actions.
Direction:
Slim vertical lacquer strip outside right edge of current court, clear of all units/spears. Five restrained symbols/short labels Declare, Infantry, Cavalry, Fight, Resolve. Fight current, small "Battle actions" popover. Right inspector holds full current details and Pass. No second large timeline or lower-court plaque.
Critical: reference inspector is STYLE ONLY. Never copy its Celestial ability prose or old source names; replace all feature-area text with this prompt’s required text only.
